keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Yanis Musuayi (Levante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Tarancón 0, Levante 0.
Substitution, Levante. Jeremy Toljan replaces Huseini Nakoha.
Second Half begins Tarancón 0, Levante 0.
Goal! Tarancón 1, Levante 0. Sergio Nieto (Tarancón) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Iván Eyi with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Levante. Petar Ratkov replaces Hugo Sotelo.
Substitution, Levante. Jon Ander Olasagasti replaces Enzo Bardeli.
Hugo García (Tarancón) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Tarancón. Joan Londoño replaces Hugo García.
Substitution, Levante. Roger Brugué replaces Víctor García.
Substitution, Levante. Thiago Fernández replaces Paco Cortés.
Substitution, Tarancón. Pedro López replaces Iván Eyi.
Goal! Tarancón 1, Levante 1. Petar Ratkov (Levante) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Tarancón. Daniel García replaces Sergio Nieto.
Second Half ends, Tarancón 1, Levante 1.
Substitution, Levante. Aïssa Mandi replaces Jorge Cabello.
First Half Extra Time begins Tarancón 1, Levante 1.
First Half Extra Time ends, Tarancón 1, Levante 1.
Second Half Extra Time begins Tarancón 1, Levante 1.
Substitution, Tarancón. Víctor Gordo replaces Naim Madkouri.
Airam Fernández (Tarancón) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Manel Usedo (Levante).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Víctor Armenteros (Tarancón) is shown the yellow card.
Daniel García (Tarancón) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Tarancón 1, Levante 2. Adrián de la Fuente (Levante) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
